title: Stamp UnreadableKind from the reader's open-versus-list phase, and make the tree and top-level rows read the stamped Kind
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: b-opened opened and then failed its first listing page, but its record says 'NothingListed', the same as the folder whose open was refused: the scan does not tell the two phases apart (OpenedThenFailedKindTests.cs:line 137)
Measure the real code-363 unreadable rows (the slice says 28) to see whether they fail at the open or at the first directory query: partial
Carry an 'opened' bit from DirectoryReader's read out to Scanner.FolderDone: missing
Stamp UnreadableKind from the phase, so a folder that opened and then failed before its first entry is no longer NothingListed / 'could not be opened': missing
FolderTreeNode.Note reads UnreadableFolder.Kind instead of working it out again from ChildCount: missing
TopLevelTracker reads the stamped Kind for the row's own folder, instead of ChildCount: missing
Align the tree's and the top-level row's 'could not be read in full' with the list's 'only partly read': missing
The list, the tree and the top-level row agree about the same folder, for a refused open, an opened-then-failed folder and a folder listed partway: missing

KindText's discard: the proposal throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException; this composition returns the neutral 'could not be read'. The every-kind Fact guards both. The choice turns on whether a missed arm should be loud at run time (the throw) or never crash a live-scan converter (the neutral words).

The new member's name, OpenedNothingListed. It is appended and NothingListed keeps its name. A rename to OpenRefused / OpenedNothingListed would read more symmetrically, but it churns corpus rows F01-F13, CheckSeamRow call sites and many tests.
The new kind's words, 'opened, but nothing could be listed', measured on all three surfaces in spike 2. Alternatives such as 'opened, but could not be listed' are equally true.

Leaving FailListingOf's page-1 refusal in place (doc-only fix), so the published exe never draws the new kind in the tree, against relaxing it in the high-risk SynchronousIoCancel.cs for one more window case.
Where the tree gets the kind: from a session lookup built from result.Unreadable (chosen), against a flag bit in ScanStore entries, which would change C-001's layout.
A window case drawing the OpenedNothingListed tree note: the design marked it not material. FailListingOf refuses page 1 by design, and relaxing it touches the high-risk SynchronousIoCancel.cs.
A scan-root test for a root that opens and fails its first page: the design marked it not material. The root still ends RootUnreadable with no record, and passes opened: true to FolderDone.
Network=SMB-LOOPBACK run: it changes network state and is a person's run (filed_for_later in the design).
Plant rows for the two engine-appended settled rules: the finding is waived to SC-337.
No architecture-record edit: no block's line (C-001 to C-005) is made untrue by this change.

The scan root still conflates the two phases: an opened root whose first page fails ends RootUnreadable exactly like a refused one, with no UnreadableFolder. Decide whether the ending text should tell them apart.
Let the published app draw an OpenedNothingListed tree note: relax FailListingOf's page-1 refusal (FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING '<leaf>|1|59') and add a window case; it touches SynchronousIoCancel.cs.

On this PC CancellationTests.CancelReturnsFromAScanBlockedOnAnUnreachableShare and ...SameUnreachableShareScannedTwice fail under --filter Network=TEST-NET-1 at HEAD too (CancelsDelivered 0 after the scan was still blocked at 500 ms). Triage whether the TEST-NET-1 premise still holds on this network.
A person runs --filter Network=SMB-LOOPBACK on this build (lesson #99), since FolderDone and DirectoryReader.Read changed.
Plant rows and an xUnit twin for the two settled rules this slice appended (carried as SC-337), including a kind phrase inside a longer App string literal.
Windows 10 and a production SMB server (Windows Server, Samba, a NAS) were not measured for the CREATE-succeeds / first-QUERY_DIRECTORY-fails ordering.

deviation: KindText takes UnreadableKind? and TitleOf's Unreadable arm is unconditional (accepted finding m1), not the `when row.FailedKind is { }` arm the design wrote; a null kind reads 'could not be read' instead of falling to the bare name.
deviation: The design's Note rule is kept, but Note no longer re-reads the Unreadable flag for wording: an entry the record does not hold reads empty.

deviation: Added a direct DirectoryReader.Opened Fact (TheReaderSaysWhetherItsLastReadGotAHandle) and Opened assertions in ContainerLayerStoreTests, beyond the design's list, to pin the bit the whole stamp rests on.

deviation: The test helper FirstPageFailure hands the Created seam only to guards made on the calling thread, because the seam is a process-wide static and other test classes run in parallel; the repro test does not do this, and was left alone.
deviation: The settled rules (m4) got no plant rows and rule 2's delimiters were not widened: that finding is waived to SC-337 (O-019), so only the twinned rule's plant F52 was added.

deviation: The existing test name AFolderListedPartwayIsNotReadInFullAndOneNeverOpenedIsNotOpened keeps its old wording; its assertions are updated. Renaming it would change a name the design's case commands refer to.

drift: No undeclared departure from the design found. Every component, contract and case row is present as designed, or as amended by the accepted findings M1, m1, m2, m3 and m6. m4 was waived to SC-337.

drift: One declared deviation rests on a false premise. FirstPageFailure's thread filter was justified as 'the seam is a process-wide static', but SynchronousIoCancel.Created is [ThreadStatic] (filed as m1, extra).

drift: No new undeclared departure from the design found in the second pass. Round 1's note stands: the declared FirstPageFailure deviation rests on a false premise, since Created is [ThreadStatic] (m1, extra).
not reviewed: tests/bugs/SL-106-OpenedThenFailedKind/OpenedThenFailedKindTests.cs: written by the repro stage and not changed by this build. I ran it (passes) but did not re-read it line by line.
not reviewed: tests/window/WindowCases.ps1: I read the CheckSeamRow, Get-OracleRow and W-001 hunks. I verified the T-007 expectation hunk by running T-007 rather than reading it.

not reached: The published WPF exe never drew an OpenedNothingListed tree note or top-level title: FailListingOf still refuses page 1 (criterion 11, marked not material by the design). The new kind was seen through the scratch driver composing Core with the App's KindText, TopLevelRowText and FolderTreeSession, not in a drawn window.

not reached: The opt-in Network=SMB-LOOPBACK xUnit suite was not run on this build. It changes SMB mappings on the host and was filed as a person's run. The Sandbox driver exercised the changed phase only.
not reached: Host Windows 11 build 26200's SMB redirector: the real-SMB measurement ran in a Sandbox on build 26100. Windows 10 was not measured.
not reached: A production SMB server (Windows Server, Samba, a NAS) that accepts CREATE and then fails the first QUERY_DIRECTORY: the server was the repo's SMBLibrary rig.
not reached: N-005 itself (the published exe on the stall rig): not run on the host because it changes SMB mappings. Its checks were read and do not pin s's kind.
not reached: --filter Network=TEST-NET-1 was not re-run. The build reported 2 failures that fail identically on HEAD c6d43e0.

critique missed: Finding m2 told the build to add `--filter Network=TEST-NET-1` (with lesson #99) as a required check, without asking whether it is green at HEAD. CancellationTests.CancelReturnsFromAScanBlockedOnAnUnreachableShare and ...SameUnreachableShareScannedTwice fail 2 of 2 at HEAD c6d43e0, so the added check could not tell a regression from the baseline. A check to ask for is: run each newly required filter on the base commit before listing it as a gate.

still unknown: Does a production SMB server (Windows Server, Samba, a NAS), or the Windows 10 or host build 26200 redirector, accept CREATE and fail the first QUERY_DIRECTORY? It was measured only with the SMBLibrary rig on a build 26100 Sandbox, so how often real users see 'opened, but nothing could be listed' is unknown.

still unknown: Would the 27 code-363 fixture folders ever open and then fail on a different cldflt build? All measurements are on cldflt.sys 10.0.26100.9444, where they fail at CreateFile. A newer build that opened them would flip those rows to the new wording. W-001 over fsa-guard-tests is the re-check.
still unknown: Do the 2 TEST-NET-1 Cancel tests fail on any network, or only because this PC's route to the unreachable address answers in about 530 ms inside the root open?

still unknown: Does the published exe's tree draw the same 'opened, but nothing could be listed' note that the Sandbox scratch driver composed from Core, KindText and FolderTreeSession? No window has drawn it yet.

went wrong: The brief's first deliverable (measure the 28 real code-363 rows with the CfProvider rig) was already answered by Q-164: 27 rows, all failing at the open. The survey probe and two Sandbox runs (run-20261012-230925 and run-20261012-231114) re-established it, and it was never the bug. The reflection that raised the candidate did not check the answered questions.
went wrong: The brief carried stale line numbers and a symbol that does not exist (DirectoryReader's ReadOutcome). Build-check had to list the corrections for the designers.

went wrong: The critique ran twice: the first pass halted with 7 findings waiting on a person, and the second passed with all 7 answered by a model, so they count as untriaged (Q-251). One finding was major: the design's consumer grep stopped at src and tests/window and missed tests/bugs, where SL-063's DoneRowFinalityTests would have gone red.

went wrong: Two findings decided accepted-pending, m4 (plants and a widened rule 2) and code-review m1 (redundant OnThisThread helper with a false 'process-wide static' doc), ended as waivers to SC-337 and SC-338. The shipped settled rule 2 stays quiet on a kind phrase inside a longer string, and the helper's false premise is in the tree.
went wrong: Code review ran twice because round 1 halted on that extra m1 finding. Round 2 found nothing new.
went wrong: The build marked O-013 discharged after a regex-only check of the F52 plant. Code review had to run the rules harness to show F52 fires in both xUnit and Fitness.

went wrong: Validate relied on the build's TEST-NET-1 result instead of re-running it, although the design had said it stays in validate. Network=SMB-LOOPBACK was not run (a person's run). The new kind was never drawn by the published exe, so the tree note for OpenedNothingListed rests on a scratch driver and unit tests.
